name: StartupBlink

sources.title: StartupBlink Global Startup Map — 120k+ startups across 1,000 cities
StartupBlink blog — 'Add Startup' via map/dashboard, submissions reviewed
Third-party walkthrough — free StartupBlink listing steps

requirements: Real startup/company — every submission is reviewed by StartupBlink against their listing criteria before appearing on the map
Submission entry point: 'Add Startup' button on the map or dashboard (also /startups/add)
preparation: Location (city/country — the map is geo-organized), industry from their 12-industry taxonomy
workflow: Register a free account at startupblink.com
Open the Startup Map / dashboard and choose 'Add Startup' (/startups/add)
Fill startup details (website, description, location, industry)
Submit — entry goes through StartupBlink's review process
On approval the startup appears on the global map and in city/country rankings
watchFor: The add-startup page returned 403 to automated fetch — the form likely requires a logged-in session/browser
This is an ecosystem map, not a launch board — value is a profile page + backlink + map placement, not launch traffic
Review can reject entries that don't meet their startup criteria
countsAsLive: The startup's profile resolves on startupblink.com and it is visible on the global startup map for its city/industry.
unknowns: Exact form fields and required vs optional metadata (page blocked automated reads)
Whether the outbound link is dofollow
